surfaces: 1) Junie CLI (standalone terminal agent, JetBrains-official, Windows/macOS/Linux); 2) Junie IDE plugin / Junie Local inside IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm, PhpStorm, Rider, etc. (also exposed as an ACP agent inside the AI Assistant tool window); 3) JetBrains AI Assistant chat inside the IDE (own store, separate from Junie); 4) Junie GitHub Action and GitLab CI (same CLI store).
binaries: junie (Windows: junie.exe). Official installers: PowerShell `iex (irm 'https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.ps1')`; shell `curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash`; `npm install -g @jetbrains/junie`; `brew tap jetbrains-junie/junie && brew install junie`. Build channels: --eap/--nightly/--experimental/--release. IDE side: the JetBrains AI Assistant plugin (com.intellij.ml.llm.*, e.g. build 262.10968.170) plus the Junie IDE plugin.

fields.project: YES for Junie CLI. events.jsonl carries `CurrentDirectoryUpdatedEvent.currentDirectory` (absolute project dir) inside SessionA2uxEvent.agentEvent; `sessions/index.jsonl` also maps sessionId -> projectDir. IDE AI Assistant: project path is NOT in the event log - it needs a 3-file join (workspace/<projectWorkspaceId>.xml -> chat uid; options/recentProjects.xml -> RecentProjectMetaInfo.projectWorkspaceId -> <entry key="$USER_HOME$/src/app">), and the IDE's AUI file paths are project-relative.
fields.model: YES for Junie CLI: `LlmResponseMetadataEvent.modelUsage[].model` (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5, gpt-5.x) on SessionA2uxEvent. IDE AI Assistant: only `chatModelId` (values like `chat_mode`, `agent_codex`, `agent_acp.registry.codex-acp`) - an agent/model id, not an LLM model, and JetBrains documents it breaking between IDE versions (SUPPORT-A-4166).
fields.file_basename: YES. Junie CLI: `ViewFilesBlockUpdatedEvent.files[].relativePath` (holds an ABSOLUTE path) and `FileChangesBlockUpdatedEvent.changes[].afterRelativePath/beforeRelativePath` (absolute). IDE AI Assistant: same block kinds but `files[].path` and `changes[].afterPath/beforePath`, project-RELATIVE. Only the basename is ever published.
fields.tool_activity: YES. `TerminalBlockUpdatedEvent` -> command/status/exitCode/output; `ViewFilesBlockUpdatedEvent` -> files read; `FileChangesBlockUpdatedEvent` -> before/after content + paths; `ToolBlockUpdatedEvent` -> tool title; `MarkdownBlockUpdatedEvent` -> agent prose (never forwarded); `ResultBlockUpdatedEvent` -> task result (never forwarded).
fields.phase: YES. Junie CLI: block kind + `status` (IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED / FAILED) and `event.state` (IN_PROGRESS vs the task-end COMPLETED replay) separate "running tools" from "thinking"; `UserPromptEvent` = new turn. IDE: same AUI block kinds, but records carry no time.
fields.timestamps: Junie CLI: every line carries `timestampMs` (epoch milliseconds), plus `event.completion.startedAtMs/endedAtMs`; index.jsonl has `createdAt`/`updatedAt`. IDE AI Assistant aia-task-history/*.events: NO per-record timestamps at all (two independent readers agree: "Records carry no time; start, one millisecond per record, keeps them in order"); the only clock is the chat's `statisticInformation.timestamp` (ms) in the workspace XML.

paths: %USERPROFILE%\.junie\sessions\index.jsonl  (one line per session: sessionId, createdAt, updatedAt, projectDir, taskName)
%USERPROFILE%\.junie\sessions\<session-id>\state.json  (agent's last state; headless run's issue description lives in event.agentEvent.blob.lastAgentState.issue.description)
%USERPROFILE%\.junie\config.json , settings.json , allowlist , sandbox.json , trust\ , models\ , extensions\ , logs\
JUNIE_HOME env var overrides the whole home (default ~/.junie; on Windows the JVM user.home == %USERPROFILE%)
IDE AI Assistant (SECONDARY, partial): %APPDATA%\JetBrains\<Product><Version>\aia-task-history\<chat-uid>.events  (base64-JSON-per-line AUI_EVENTS_V1 log)
NOT FOUND / UNVERIFIED: %APPDATA%\JetBrains\<Product><Version>\ai\  (the path named in the brief) - no evidence it exists; JetBrains' own config-dir listing has no 'ai' folder
storage.format: Junie CLI: plain JSONL, one event per line, shape {kind, timestampMs, ...}. SessionA2uxEvent wraps {event:{state, agentEvent:{kind, stepId, ...}}}. IDE AI Assistant: IntelliJ PersistentStateComponent XML for chats + a separate event log that is a literal first line 'AUI_EVENTS_V1' followed by one base64-encoded JSON record per line. No SQLite, no protobuf, no markdown-only store, no encryption, no auth token needed to read.
storage.append_semantics: Junie CLI events.jsonl: APPEND-ONLY and LIVE - the CLI appends each event while the agent works (a block is updated in place by later lines carrying the same stepId; a finished task replays all of its blocks once more with event.state='COMPLETED'; Junie's own PreToolUse hook reads the log mid-run to find the newest failed command). Existing Discodex LogTailer works unchanged. IDE AI Assistant: the aia-task-history/*.events log is likewise line-appended under a versioned header, BUT the authoritative chat metadata (model id, chat start time, project mapping) lives in workspace/*.xml which the IDE REWRITES WHOLESALE (JetBrains' own article warns the IDE may overwrite the workspace folder on shutdown) - a tailer cannot be used for it, and the .events records carry no timestamps.
storage.session_file_naming: Junie CLI: one directory per session, named by session id; the log inside is always events.jsonl (<JUNIE_HOME>/sessions/<session-id>/events.jsonl). sessions/index.jsonl is the sidecar index (sessionId, createdAt, updatedAt, projectDir, taskName). Resume: junie --session-id <id> or junie junie://sessions/<id>. IDE AI Assistant: <Product><Version>/aia-task-history/<chat-uid>.events and <chat-uid>.agentsession, where chat-uid is the SerializedChat 'uid' option in workspace/<projectWorkspaceId>.xml; the workspace file is named after the project workspace id, not its path.

parser_strategy:
NEW PROVIDER `Provider::Junie` -> `parse_line_for(Provider::Junie, line)` (one JSON object per line, no base64, no XML).

Line dispatch on the top-level "kind" string:
- "UserPromptEvent"                -> ParsedEvent::TaskStarted { started_at_ms: timestampMs }   (turn boundary; the prompt text is read but NEVER emitted)
- "TaskStartedEvent"               -> ParsedEvent::Thinking { reasoning: None }
- "TaskState" (state=COMPLETED|FAILED|CANCELED) -> ParsedEvent::Completed
- "SessionA2uxEvent"               -> read value["event"]["agentEvent"]:
    * event.state == "COMPLETED"  -> SKIP the whole record (task-end replay of every block; ignoring it prevents double-firing tools)
    * "CurrentDirectoryUpdatedEvent" -> currentDirectory (non-empty) -> SessionMetadata { project: project_name(cwd), cwd }
    * "LlmResponseMetadataEvent"  -> modelUsage[].model -> AgentDetected { agent: sanitized_model }  (allowlist: alnum + "-_.:/@", <=128 chars, else dropped)
    * "TerminalBlockUpdatedEvent" -> status IN_PROGRESS -> TrackedToolStarted { call_id: stepId, activity { label: classify_tool("terminal", command), file: None } }; status COMPLETED|FAILED -> TrackedToolFinished { call_id: stepId }
    * "ViewFilesBlockUpdatedEvent"-> status IN_PROGRESS -> TrackedToolStarted { call_id: stepId, activity { label: "Reading project files", file: basename(files[].relativePath), language: language_from_file } }; COMPLETED -> TrackedToolFinished
    * "FileChangesBlockUpdatedEvent" -> status IN_PROGRESS -> TrackedToolStarted { call_id: stepId, activity { label: "Editing files", file: basename(changes[].afterRelativePath ?? beforeRelativePath), language } }; COMPLETED -> TrackedToolFinished
    * "ToolBlockUpdatedEvent"      -> ToolStarted { label: "Using development tools" }   (its `text` is agent prose -> never emitted)
    * "MarkdownBlockUpdatedEvent"  -> Thinking { reasoning: None }   (text never emitted)
    * "ResultBlockUpdatedEvent"    -> TerminalCandidate             (result/title never emitted)
    * "ContextCompactionBlockUpdatedEvent" -> Thinking { reasoning: None }
    * "AgentCurrentStatusUpdatedEvent"     -> Thinking { reasoning: None }
    * "AgentTaskNameUpdatedEvent" -> NO EVENT (task name is user-visible content)
- "UserMessagesCommittedToHistory" -> no event
- unknown kind / malformed JSON   -> no event (fail safe)

Reuse: classify_tool() for the command label (returns a fixed label only, never command text), basename()/language_from_file() for the file, project_name() for the folder, and a new model-id sanitizer cloned from deepseek_model_label().
Privacy: the only values that can reach Discord are the provider name, project folder name, file basename, language, a fixed activity label, the model id, the phase and the start time.

SECONDARY (IDE AI Assistant) parser, if pursued: `parse_line_for` would first base64-decode the line (new `base64` crate dependency) and strip the `com.intellij.ml.llm.aui.events.api.` prefix from `kind`; the same block mapping applies, but the file field is `files[].path` / `changes[].afterPath` (project-relative) and the model id / project / start time must come from a SEPARATE whole-file re-read of workspace/<id>.xml + options/recentProjects.xml - which does not fit the line-oriented parse_line_for contract and needs a new state key.

CHURN / FAIL-SAFE
- The event schema is internal to Junie and Junie ships daily-ish channels (eap/nightly/experimental), so `kind` strings and AUI block names can change. Fail safe: only a known `kind` with a recognisable shape emits anything; unknown kinds are ignored; a record with no stepId is not treated as a tool (so no orphaned TrackedToolStarted); and if the schema changes, the session simply stops producing new events and the existing 180 s stale timeout in state.rs retires the presence instead of showing a wrong state.
- The IDE-side chatModelId values (agent_codex -> agent_acp.registry.codex-acp) are documented by JetBrains to break between IDE versions - so the model/agent string must be treated as opaque and sanitized, never required.
- Do NOT set a synthetic "active" state from a bare "the file changed" event; activity must always come from a recognized block.
- If a future AUI_EVENTS_V2 header appears, the IDE-side reader must require the exact header and skip the file otherwise.

risks: Schema churn: the Junie event kinds and AUI block names are internal, undocumented APIs and Junie ships eap/nightly/experimental builds. Mitigation: strict allowlist of known kinds, ignore unknown ones, require stepId before emitting a tracked tool, and let the existing 180 s stale timeout retire the presence if parsing stops.

Task-end replay: Junie re-emits every block with event.state='COMPLETED' at the end of a task. Without the skip rule, every tool would fire twice and the phase would flap. This is the single easiest way to get the adapter wrong.

Privacy trap: the log contains prompts, results, terminal output and full source before/after content. The parser must read only stepId, status, kind, model, cwd and the path fields, and emit only basenames - the existing Discodex helpers (classify_tool/basename/language_from_file) already guarantee this, but a new 'extract the path from files[]/changes[]' helper must not leak the absolute path.
JUNIE_HOME / non-default homes: using only dirs::home_dir() would miss a relocated store. The env var must be honoured or the adapter silently reports nothing.
JVM user.home vs $HOME: Junie resolves .junie under the JVM's user.home; on Windows that equals %USERPROFILE% (== dirs::home_dir()), but a JVM started with a custom -Duser.home would differ.

IDE AI Assistant store is NOT a clean fit: the workspace XML is rewritten wholesale by the IDE, the AUI records have no timestamps, the project path needs a 3-file join (workspace xml + recentProjects.xml + aia-task-history), the file paths are project-relative, and the chat id and the .events id must be joined across two different ActivityState session keys (path-keyed). It also needs a new base64 dependency. Treat it as a separate, later provider.
No per-message or per-record timestamps in the IDE store, so the elapsed timer can only be anchored on the chat start from the XML - a rewritten file - and the phase cannot be timed.

The 'agent_' chatModelId values are documented by JetBrains to break on IDE upgrades (SUPPORT-A-4166); any mapping to a model name must be best-effort and sanitized, never required for the adapter to work.

Multiple concurrent Junie sessions and subagents write into the same sessions tree; sessions/index.jsonl and the subagents/ folder must not be mistaken for session logs (the grandparent=='sessions' rule handles this).

The logo asset is pinned to @lobehub/icons-static-png@1.97.0; if the package drops 'junie-color.png' the Discord image will 404 - same risk the existing providers already carry, but worth noting when the version is bumped.
confidence: High for the Junie CLI store (official JetBrains docs + the official JetBrains/junie repo + a mature third-party reader with redacted fixtures all agree, and the file format is plain text). Medium-high for the IDE AI Assistant store (confirmed by two official JetBrains support articles and a reference implementation that decompiled the plugin, but the internals are undocumented and version-dependent). The '%APPDATA%\JetBrains\<Product><Version>\ai' path in the brief could not be corroborated by any source and should be treated as wrong.
summary: JetBrains does write a local, unencrypted, machine-readable activity log, but not where the brief assumed. There is no %APPDATA%\JetBrains\<Product><Version>\ai directory; the real stores are (1) the Junie CLI at %USERPROFILE%\.junie\sessions\<session-id>\events.jsonl - plain append-only JSONL, one event per line, every line carrying timestampMs, containing the project cwd, the LLM model id, the file paths (absolute), the terminal commands, the turn boundaries and the completion - and (2) the in-IDE AI Assistant at %APPDATA%\JetBrains\<Product><Version>\aia-task-history\<chat-uid>.events (base64-JSON-per-line under an AUI_EVENTS_V1 header) whose chat metadata sits in workspace\<projectWorkspaceId>.xml, an XML the IDE rewrites whole and which carries no per-record timestamps. The Junie CLI store reaches Codex/DSH richness (project + model + file basename + normalized tool label + phase + elapsed timer) and plugs into Discodex with ZERO watcher/main.rs changes because the existing LogTailer already handles append-only line-delimited JSON; the only shared-code edits are a new Provider::Junie variant, a filename rule for events.jsonl, a parse_junie_line() mapper and adding 'timestampMs' to line_timestamp_ms(). The IDE AI Assistant store alone is only partial: it needs base64 decoding (new dependency), a whole-file re-read path for the rewritten XML, a 3-file join (workspace xml + recentProjects.xml + aia-task-history) to recover the project, and a change to the path-keyed ActivityState so the chat and its event log share one session. Privacy is preserved in both cases: only the provider name, project folder name, file basename, language, a fixed activity label, the model id, the phase and the start time may leave the machine - prompts, results, terminal output, tool arguments, task names and full paths are read but never emitted.
